market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI active month closed near $94.40/bbl on April 25, 2026 with intraday range $92.68-$97.85. To hit $110 by April 30 requires a further ~14% spike with only 2-3 trading days left. Strong week (+13%) on geopolitical risk, but reaching $110 demands a fresh major escalation (Strait of Hormuz closure, etc.). Tail-risk only.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran/US talks or Strait of Hormuz disruption could trigger a rapid spike; otherwise reaching $110 in days is unlikely.
